# prix token

## Defilam

```{r}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)

# L'adresse du WETH sur Gnosis est 0x6a023ccd1ff6f2045c3309768ead9e68f978f6e1
# Note: Defillama utilise le préfixe "xdai:" pour Gnosis
url_defillama <- "https://coins.llama.fi/prices/current/xdai:0x6a023ccd1ff6f2045c3309768ead9e68f978f6e1"

response <- GET(url_defillama)
data <- fromJSON(content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))

prix_weth_gnosis <- data$coins$`xdai:0x6a023ccd1ff6f2045c3309768ead9e68f978f6e1`$price
cat("Prix du WETH sur Gnosis via DefiLlama : $", prix_weth_gnosis, "\n")
```

```{r}
token_adress = "0x2a22f9c3b484c3629090feed35f17ff8f88f76f0"
token_symbol = "USDCe"

url_defillama <- paste0("https://coins.llama.fi/prices/current/xdai:", token_adress)

response <- GET(url_defillama)
data <- fromJSON(content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))

prix <- data$coins[[paste0("xdai:", token_adress)]]$price
cat(paste0("Prix du ", token_symbol, " sur Gnosis via DefiLlama : $", prix, "\n"))
```

## DexScreener

marche pas

```{r}
#| eval: false
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)

# Adresse du contrat WETH sur Gnosis
token_address <- "0x6a023ccd1ff6f2045c3309768ead9e68f978f6e1"
url_dexscreener <- paste0("https://api.dexscreener.com/latest/dex/tokens/", token_address)

response <- GET(url_dexscreener)
data <- fromJSON(content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))

# DexScreener renvoie toutes les pools associées à ce token, on filtre sur Gnosis
# et on prend le premier résultat pertinent
pairs <- data$pairs
gnosis_pairs <- pairs[pairs$chainId == "gnosis", ]

if (nrow(gnosis_pairs) > 0) {
  prix_weth_gnosis <- as.numeric(gnosis_pairs$priceUsd[1])
  cat("Prix du WETH sur Gnosis via DexScreener : $", prix_weth_gnosis, "\n")
} else {
  cat("Impossible de trouver des paires sur Gnosis pour ce token.\n")
}

```

## oku

```{r}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)

url <- "https://omni.icarus.tools/gnosis/cush/searchPoolsByAddress"

# Création de la liste R qui sera convertie en JSON
payload <- list(
  params = list(
    "0xe8a249626d3f3b876b887c30a3355513cb3fa9e4",
    list(
      result_size = 2,
      sort_by = "tvl_usd",
      sort_order = FALSE
    )
  )
)

# Requête POST vers l'API
response <- httr::POST(
  url,
  add_headers(Accept = "application/json"),
  content_type_json(),
  body = jsonlite::toJSON(payload, auto_unbox = TRUE)
)

# Parsing de la réponse
if (status_code(response) == 200) {
  parsed_data <- httr::content(response, as = "parsed", type = "application/json")
  
  # Extraction des données de la pool
  pool <- parsed_data$result$pools[[1]]
  
  cat(sprintf("Paire : %s / %s\n", pool$t0_symbol, pool$t1_symbol))
  cat(sprintf("Dernier prix : %f\n", pool$last_price))
  cat(paste0(pool$t0_symbol, " = ", pool$t0_price_usd, "\n"))
  cat(paste0(pool$t1_symbol, " = ", pool$t1_price_usd, "\n"))
  
} else {
  cat(sprintf("Erreur HTTP : %s\n", status_code(response)))
}
```
